targets.label: v0.2
targets.name: Dependable at home
targets.summary: Matinee keeps working when the internet is down, your watch history survives a replaced or renamed file, a wrong match is easy to fix, and when playback stutters Matinee tells you why. More files play as they are, and HDR looks right when it has to be converted.

targets.label: v0.3
targets.name: Plays everything well
targets.summary: Subtitles with their full styling, timing and audio delay controls, Dolby Vision handled for each kind of screen, several versions of a film under one title, and a TV app where your libraries are one press away.

targets.label: v0.4
targets.name: Your library, your way
targets.summary: Better matching for unusual names, extras, local .nfo files, a Home screen you arrange yourself, sign-in with your own identity provider, and streaming limits for each person.

targets.label: Ongoing
targets.name: More devices
targets.summary: Getting the apps into more stores, alongside the releases above.

targets.label: Later
targets.name: Ideas we want to build
targets.summary: Not scheduled yet. If one of these matters to you, say so on its issue, or pick it up: help is welcome.
